verdict.rationale: Baseten hosts a working llms.txt (confirmed live at HTTP 200) plus a dedicated agent-setup page with .md-suffixed docs pages designed for agent consumption, and even documents installing a Baseten skill/MCP server so agents can search these docs directly. This is strong, verified first-party plus probe-confirmed evidence of agent-oriented documentation access. Missing for 10: independent/community confirmation that an agent successfully used llms.txt in practice.
